name.value: Kootenay Lakeview Resort BW Signature Collection

description.value: An intimate 20-room lakeside resort spread across 60 acres above the western shores of Kootenay Lake, part of the Best Western Signature Collection. Positioned just minutes north of Nelson and 10 minutes south of Ainsworth Hot Springs, it sits at a strategically convenient point for cyclists touring the Kootenay corridor. Every suite features a private balcony overlooking the lake, and the resort grounds include outdoor barbecue areas, pet washing stations, and a ballroom conference centre.

raw_osm.name: Kootenay Lakeview Resort BW Signature Collection

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM name, phone (1.250.229.4141), and address (1285 Queens Bay). The amenities page explicitly lists 'Free Highspeed WiFi' for both suites and resort-wide, confirming Wi-Fi. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, drying area, e-bike charging, pump, tools, or bike wash anywhere on the site — these are all null. The resort is clearly active with a 2026 copyright and live booking functionality.
concerns: No bike-specific amenities (storage, tools, wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website; cyclists should contact the property directly to ask.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active hotel with a functioning website and live booking system. Useful stopover for cyclists on the Kootenay Lake corridor between Nelson and Ainsworth Hot Springs.
